prompt: The client asks: "Should we move our call center offshore?" Fact sheet: offshoring saves $5M a year; the move costs $8M once; satisfaction is expected to drop 10 points; each point of satisfaction lost costs $300k a year; our hurdle is a 3-year payback; the vendor has offices in three countries. Which is the best recommendation?

options.text: Don't move the call center offshore. The $5M saving shrinks to about $2M once a 10-point satisfaction drop costs $3M a year, so the $8M move takes 4 years to pay back, beyond the 3-year hurdle. The main risk is that costs at home keep rising, so the next step is to look for savings through self-service and better scheduling.
options.feedback: Right. It leads with the answer, backs it with the numbers that matter, and gives a risk and a next step.
